text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This... is a race course... How did I...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My body sounds like a... motorcycle
engine!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is awesome! I got power runnin'
through my
entire body!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what's goin' on, but I know my
running is
gonna be super cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right! Since I'm here,
I may as well go
for a test
drive!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-hey, Vodka! You can't just jump out
and scare
me like that!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Scarlet. What happened to my
power? My
test drive?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good grief... Pull yourself together already. Don't tell me you were having another weird dream.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You were all "engine this" and "engine
that" while you were asleep... This is
what happens when you
fall asleep
reading those motorcycle magazines.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: A dream... Yeah. It was all a dream.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But I can still feel the sensation!
Time to
get
straight to trainin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Vodka's running improves thanks to her
recent
dream!
